They then sent two completion reports for a different property (Flat 7, 177 Beacon Close, Kingshaven), so there is no proof the work at Flat 20, 120 Lantern Quay was done. I emailed the contractor to confirm whether and when they attended and what they did, and asked the tenant whether the window now works. The ticket is on hold with a follow-up in 2 days and stays in 'works'.

Event 018 set the visit date only after those reports came in, and it was backdated to 12/12. Event 021 says there are no work results. So we can't say the job is done. The contractor and the tenant can both clear this up, so I asked them before escalating.
